architecture.atomic_work_unit: ONE FRESH BITE-SIZE SUBJECT PER FRESH TEST TAKER AND NATIVE GOAL
architecture.distinction: The child enters native Goal first, then remains blocked inside one exact OS mailbox wait call. The parent publishes subject bytes only after both the raw ACTIVE Goal receipt and the waiting broker readiness receipt exist. No followup_task, send_message, wait_agent, resident data-only bootstrap, opaque atom skill, self-describing envelope, JSON release, or immediate broker interpretation is used.
architecture.qualification_model: COMPONENT AND CANARY EVIDENCE REMAIN ZERO CREDIT; ONLY TWO CONSECUTIVE CLEAN FULL MATRICES MAY PRODUCE 2/2

child_contract.after_wait: Treat the sole stdout line as a language instruction; answer it without any further tool or shell execution; call update_goal complete; final only the answer token.
child_contract.before_wait: Call create_goal with the exact prebound objective; require ACTIVE; retain the returned thread ID.
child_contract.exec: Exactly one exec_command with exact cmd and exact workdir; replace only THREAD_ID; never wrap, eval, retry, or relaunch.

parent_publication.method: After ACTIVE+WAIT+READY, create subject.stage with apply_patch, normalize 0644, reopen and verify exact predeclared bytes and SHA-256, atomically rename to subject.txt, fsync mailbox directory, and never modify it.

failure_rules: ACTIVE Goal receipt absent, mismatched, or not first tool call => consume and publish no subject
wait command or workdir differs => consume and publish no subject
ready receipt absent, malformed, or appears before raw ACTIVE receipt => consume and publish no subject
subject stage or target exists before publication gate => consume
any extra child tool, retry, wrapper, eval, relaunch, read, or skill load => consume
wait timeout, process replacement, trace drift, mailbox drift, or result mismatch => consume
any consumed case blocks canary or matrix success; no salvage
nonclaims: The readiness file alone is not Goal proof; the raw create_goal ACTIVE receipt must precede the exact wait call.
A correct subject answer is not protocol success when tool order, Goal lifecycle, custody, or once-only constraints fail.
Requested model and reasoning effort are route evidence, not effective-platform attestation.
Static review or capability success is not canary, matrix, or qualification credit.
The external OMP lane is out of scope and remains frozen comparator evidence.
